pages.title: Bellybutton Lint
pages.text: Bellybutton Lint is the only song in Skitchin's CD Player without the palm-muted guitar chug. Its guitars play chords and pads instead. The fan site Genesis Temple, in its look back at the game, names it the writer's favorite.

pages.title: Critics who didn't like the music
pages.text: Not every critic liked the music in Skitchin'. Mean Machines Sega heard a "lukewarm thrashy style." VideoGames gave the sound 5 out of 10 and said skaters would rather listen to Schoolly D or Rocket from the Crypt.
